exclusions.source_text: Patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Known active HIV or hepatitis infection. Patients with HIV that is well-controlled and have undetectable viral titers remain eligible.
Infratentorial, recurrent, leptomeningeal or extracranial disease.
Calculated creatinine clearance (CrCl) \> 30 mL/min using Cockcroft and Gault for-mula:
Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 times upper limit of normal (ULN) except in patients with Gilbert's disease for which total bilirubin must be ≤ 2 times ULN
exclusions.threshold: bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN (<= 2 x ULN in Gilbert's)

exclusions.source_text: Aspartate transaminase AST (SGOT) and alanine aminotransferase ALT (SGPT) ≤ 3 times the ULN
